reason: Integrates DeepSeek Harness with a locally installed CloakBrowser to let an agent browse, inspect, and interact with web pages, including optional visual understanding.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到本地安装的 CloakBrowser，为智能体提供网页浏览、页面交互、标签页管理、截图和可选视觉理解能力。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to a locally installed CloakBrowser, enabling agent-driven web browsing, page interaction, tab management, screenshots, and optional visual understanding.

capabilities: Launch and control a local browser session
Open, navigate, inspect, and interact with web pages
Manage tabs, cookies, persistent profiles, and browser storage
Evaluate page scripts and capture screenshots
Send selected viewport screenshots to a user-configured visual understanding endpoint
